name: mock-tiered
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 agent that works under the access tier a message names (access-tier/v1, ADR 0061; local development only). It lists all four tiers, its default is auto, and it says in its answer which tier it was told.

extensions.description: Works under the access tier a message names, never above it, and says which.

skills.name: Work under a tier
skills.description: Does a piece of work under the access tier the message names, and says which tier it worked under.
